name: xarm7
notes: Used existing site link_tcp on xarm_gripper_base_link at 0 0 0.172. Finger bodies separated along y (left at y=+0.035, right at y=-0.035) and extend along +z (knuckle z~0.059 to pads z~0.13-0.15), so approach palm->fingertips is +z in base-link/site frame and closing is y-axis. Chose +y for closing (symmetric). Site has no quat so frame = body frame. Gripper actuator 'gripper' drives tendon 'split' (left+right driver) ctrlrange 0-255; home keyframe has gripper ctrl 0 and driver qpos 0, assumed open, so open=0 closed=255. Unsure of open/closed polarity and whether link_tcp (z=0.172, slightly beyond pads at ~0.15) is exactly between pads vs fingertip; may need ee_add offset if grasp is high/low and may need swapped open/closed.
